titles: Captain’s log: a tribute to Sir Patrick Stewart and Captain Picard
Make it so: a full coding agent you command by voice, built on OpenCode
I command a full coding agent by voice, like Captain Picard
description: A tribute to Sir Patrick Stewart (1940–2026) and Captain Jean-Luc Picard.

Picard Code is a full coding agent you command by voice, built on OpenCode 2. Speak your orders; the computer and the bridge crew plan, build and test real work in your own projects, with any AI provider OpenCode supports. Nothing runs without the Captain’s approval.

Everything in the bridge scenes is the real app, recorded live: the Captain spoke, the crew answered, asked for approval five times and built a real tribute site with a stardate clock. Only the waiting was cut.
{chapters}
Try it: npx picard-code
Website: https://sbroenne.github.io/picard-code
Source: https://github.com/sbroenne/picard-code
Voices: all voices are computer-made with stock Kokoro voices. No voice was cloned or imitated.
Computer sounds: TrekCore (trekcore.com). Music and bridge sounds: the Star Trek: The Next Generation pinball sound collection (1993).
Made with HyperFrames.
Unofficial fan tribute. Not affiliated with Sir Patrick Stewart, Paramount or the Star Trek rights holders. Star Trek and related marks belong to their owners.

es.title: Diario del capitán: un homenaje a Sir Patrick Stewart y al capitán Picard
description: Un homenaje a Sir Patrick Stewart (1940–2026) y al capitán Jean-Luc Picard.

Picard Code es un agente de programación completo que se maneja con la voz, construido sobre OpenCode 2. Usted da las órdenes en voz alta; el ordenador y la tripulación del puente planifican, construyen y prueban trabajo real en sus propios proyectos, con cualquier proveedor de IA compatible con OpenCode. Nada se ejecuta sin la aprobación del capitán.
Todas las escenas del puente muestran la aplicación real, grabada en directo. Solo se recortaron las esperas.
{chapters}

Web: https://sbroenne.github.io/picard-code
